Related question. I have Mattias in play and my preditor is playing
Settites. Mattias gives Settites -1 bleed while bleeding me. Can they
Spying Mission me if I don't block (assuming a bleed of 1)?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


If you assume a bleed of 1 (successful), yes.

If you have a bleed of 0 (the usual when a Setite bleeds Matthias's
controller: 1-1=0), zero being unsuccessful as stated in the rules,
then no.


